verdict.rationale: The pack shows event-triggered workflows ("Trigger workflows from ClickUp events"), a bare "Automations" product label, and an always-on "Super Agent" claim, but nothing documents time-based or recurring scheduling of jobs or workflows. Event triggers are an adjacent capability, not a recurring schedule, and n8n is a third-party tool. Scheduling is a fair axis for a work-management platform with automations, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
